item.title: Version 1.0.34
item.description:
tighter onboarding + better "all set" pro tips

- Removed the forced "Move apps to App Library" onboarding step.
  Cuts the flow from 7 to 6 steps.  That guidance is now an
  optional tip on the final screen instead of a forced action.

- New ANCHOR APP pro tip on the final screen.  Teaches users to
  keep a system app (Messages / Notes / Camera) next to their
  distractions so apps return to the same spots after unflip —
  no home-screen reshuffle.

- App Library is offered as a secondary optional tip for users
  who want distractions gone entirely.
